agni.why: The sacred fire on its marigold kunda under the names: the design in one frame.

bagaicha.why: Names over the garden path and flower arch; the 3D walk behind it reads best here.

chitra.why: Mithila peacocks, the framed photo and big names: richer than the plain navy cover.

dhaka.why: Roses around the dhaka envelope and wax seal, names readable: the prettiest frame.

dhoka.why: The golden door of Patan with the names above it is the whole idea of the design.

durbar.why: The five-storey pagoda over the names card: a real moment of the walk, better than the cover.

ghar.why: The names over the lamp-lit courtyard temple; the film starts on a black screen.

gurans.why: The flower gate with शुभ विवाह and the names card: the Phoolbari look itself.

hariyo.why: The painted couple in the white gazebo with peacocks and the names in script.

himal.why: Dawn over the Himalaya with the names large; the gate is mostly dark sky.

janti.why: The Newari street, the band and the names banner together.

jhyal.why: The carved window just opened, names glowing inside; closed, the lattice hides them.

kham.why: The red wax seal on the letterpress envelope with the names: calm and premium.

laali.why: Lanterns, the painted couple and the names in script; the gate is mostly empty pink.

mahal.why: Ganesh, the palace balcony at night and the gold script names.

mala.why: The marigold canopy and brass kalash framing big names.

mandap.why: The bride at the 3D mandap with the names card, just after entering; the cover hides the scene.

mangal.why: The ornate red doors with marigolds and the names plaque: richer than the plain red first screen.

mehendi.why: Hennaed hands joining above the names.

nimantrana.why: The printed card on green with शुभ विवाह, the names and flowers.

pardaa.why: Curtains open on the mandap and the couple, names on top.

rajdwar.why: The golden gate with the silk bow is the signature; its first screen is a plain red card.

rangoli.why: The names over the flower rangoli and its diya on the brick floor.

sayapatri.why: Marigold toran over the names card: warm and clear.

shree.why: Gold Ganesh and hanging lamps over the script names on plum.

sindoor.why: Big names with the sindoor box blooming red: the design's own moment.

swayambar.why: The couple exchanging garlands, names below.
